newsitem.title: USA: Robotic Vision sees Q2 EPS $0.03 - $0.05.
newsitem.headline: Robotic Vision sees Q2 EPS $0.03 - $0.05.

text.p: Robotic Vision Systems Inc said on Friday it expects to report earnings in the range of $0.03 to $0.05 per share on revenues of about $32 million for the second fiscal quarter.
The company said the revenue shortfall is primarily related to its semiconductor related business, which was affected by customers deferring deliveries to the third quarter.

The company said that, in the past, short lead times of three to four weeks and less between the receipt and shipment of orders have been common and as a result, the company went into fiscal 1997 with a low semiconductor backlog. However, the company said, a significant number of orders received in the second quarter do not call for shipment until the third quarter.

As revenues are not recognized until shipment, revenues that otherwise would have been recognized in the second quarter under the earlier short lead times will now be recognized in the third quarter, the company said.
Analysts on average had expected second quarter earnings per share to be $0.11, according to First Call.
